title: Adic completion is exact on finite modules over a Noetherian ring
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] and $I\subseteq A$ an ideal. For an $A$-module $P$ let $P^\wedge=\varprojlim_nP/I^nP$ (compatible sequences $(x_n)_n$, $x_n\in P/I^nP$, componentwise $A$-module structure; for $P=A$ this is the ring $A^\wedge$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]), and for an $A$-linear $u:P\to Q$ let $u^\wedge:P^\wedge\to Q^\wedge$, $(x_n)_n\mapsto(u(x_n))_n$ (with $u(x_n)$ the class of $u$ of a lift). If $0\to K\xrightarrow{u}N\xrightarrow{v}M\to0$ is an exact sequence of finitely generated $A$-modules [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] ($u$ injective, $\operatorname{im}u=\ker v$, $v$ surjective), then $0\to K^\wedge\xrightarrow{u^\wedge}N^\wedge\xrightarrow{v^\wedge}M^\wedge\to0$ is exact: $u^\wedge$ is injective, $\operatorname{im}u^\wedge=\ker v^\wedge$ and $v^\wedge$ is surjective. (The maps $u^\wedge,v^\wedge$ are also $A^\wedge$-linear for the action $(a_n)_n\cdot(x_n)_n=(a_nx_n)_n$.)
